name: Designer wall-hung sanitary ware
summary: Sanitary ware that a famous designer shapes as a clean object. A WC hangs on the wall, the cistern hides in the wall, and a basin sits on the counter as a thin, sharp bowl.

philosophy.core_thesis: A bathroom fitting is a designed object, so the ceramic has a clear, simple shape that floats off the floor.
design_principles: Hang the WC on the wall at 400 mm seat height, and leave the floor free below it.
Hide the cistern in a frame of steel inside the wall, with a plate of 2 buttons.
Shape the bowl as a clear geometric form: an oval, a circle or a rounded square.
Make a counter-top basin with a wall of 6 to 10 mm and a straight, sharp edge.
Use one white glaze, or a satin glaze in a few quiet colours.
Keep the bowl rimless, so that the inside is easy to clean.
Match the shapes of the WC, the basin and the bidet in one family.
anti_patterns: A floor-standing pan with a visible cistern
A moulded flower or a printed pattern on the bowl
A bowl with a hard, sharp edge on the inside
A mix of unrelated shapes in one set

form.shape: A wall-hung WC and bidet, a counter-top bowl, a thin vanity basin and a flat shower tray, all in one design family.
form.profile: Clear geometry: a soft oval or a rounded square, with straight walls and a thin, sharp edge.
form.foot_and_rim: No foot; a hidden bracket on the wall, and a thin straight rim, 6 to 10 mm, on the basin.
form.proportion: WC 540 to 580 mm out from the wall and 360 mm wide; basin wall 6 to 10 mm; bowl diameter 400 to 600 mm.
rules: Keep one geometry through the set: for example one oval.
Hide every fixing, pipe and cistern behind the wall.
Keep the edge thin and straight on a counter basin.
Choose white, or a satin glaze in a quiet shade.

bodies.rule: Use a dense, fine, white vitreous body that holds a thin wall of 6 mm without warping. Metal and wood are for the frame and the seat only.

methods: fitting of the frame and the plate
forming.joins: The WC hangs on two steel studs in a frame inside the wall; the seat is a separate plastic part with a slow-close hinge.
forming.details: A flat, ground back where the piece meets the wall, a flush glaze with no pinholes, and a very thin, even edge.

glaze.pattern: No pattern. Form carries the design; at most a single, shallow groove or a soft ridge.
glaze.gloss: High gloss, about 90 GU, for the white pieces; satin pieces are about 30 to 40 GU.
glaze.wear: Almost none: the surface stays sharp, and only the seat and the buttons show use.

palette.strategy: White first, then a few quiet satin tones: grey, sand and black, with steel and glass as the only accent.

firing.kiln: A gas tunnel kiln with a computer cycle, and a second kiln for small series.
processes: check the form with a laser
assemble the frame and the plate
firing.scale: A large plant makes the main line; a small series of coloured or large basins is made on a short run.
firing.signs: A thin, even edge, a ground and flat back, and a laser-etched mark under the rim.

pieces.form: Wall-hung WC with a soft oval bowl and a hidden fixing
Counter-top oval basin with a 7 mm wall and a straight edge
Wall-hung urinal with a clean, flat front
Flat shower tray with a hidden outlet and a thin edge

evidence.title: Duravit works at Hornberg with a giant basin

emotion.target_response: A cool, quiet calm: the viewer sees a plain form that floats, and thinks of a gallery, a spa or a hotel.

use_cases: a render of a minimal spa bathroom
a product spec for a design collection
avoid_when: the brief wants a period bathroom

modifiers.how: Keep the wall-hung form and add a heated seat with a hidden nozzle and a remote.
Change to a floor-standing pan, add a high cistern and a transfer print.

wall_thickness.note: A fine vitreous basin keeps a wall of 6 mm.
